Internship / Co-op Description

This exciting internship / co-op is to be part of North America's Transformation Team to explore tech trends, develop domain expertise, and craft solutions for real-world business challenges.

Internship / Co-op Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with global teams and senior leaders on internal initiatives aligned to our strategic partners.
  • Initiatives will offer practical experience and exposure to the Wipro organization.
  • Identify business requirements, translate into an actionable plan, and produce quality work.
  • Participate in key meetings with partner leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
  • Engage and network with senior leaders who provide focused mentorship and leadership coaching.
  • Demonstrate leadership qualities and self-confidence working collaboratively in a team environment.
